logic.explanation: The model uses `sum_j x[i,j] <= y[i]`, which limits each clinic to at most one assigned neighborhood. This makes the problem infeasible when more than one neighborhood must be served by a single clinic. The correct constraint is `x[i,j] <= y[i]` for every clinic–neighborhood pair, allowing any number of assignments as long as the clinic is opened.
logic.fix: Replace the linking constraint with `x[i,j] <= y[i]` for all i in clinic_ids and j in neighborhood_ids. Remove the existing sum constraint or modify it to `sum_j x[i,j] <= y[i] * len(neighborhood_ids)` if a single constraint is preferred.
